name: Yotsubana Sakura ~Haru e to Tsumugu Yukidoke no Tegami~
original_name: ヨツバナサクラ～春へと紡ぐ雪どけの手紙～
source:
It's been four years since I started creating, and I was worried about the results at the end of autumn.
A fan letter arrived to Ryota Kadokura, a boy who aims to become a novelist.

"A story should be built by theory."

A reader who doesn't know his face or name preached "Theoretical system of creation" to him who has continued to create by relying only on his passion.
And from this day, his daily life begins to change drastically.

――Beyond the chilling reality, to the other side of the dream of dancing cherry blossoms.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6468]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
开始创作已经四年了，秋末的时候我还在担心结果。
立志成为小说家的男孩角仓亮太收到了一封粉丝来信。

“故事应该由理论​​构建。”

一位不认识他的面孔、不认识他的名字的读者，向仅仅依靠自己的热情持续创作的他宣讲了“创作的理论体系”。
而从这一天起，他的日常生活开始发生巨大的变化。

——超越令人毛骨悚然的现实，​​来到舞动樱花的梦想的彼岸。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6468]NovelGame[/url]]
